nodes.label: desktop memory - context_precision_llm_ref is not scored

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The v3 eval does not score context_precision_llm_ref (RAGAS LLMContextPrecisionWithReference): it is commented out of eval/ragas_catalog.py's SELECTED, now the single explicit list of metrics a run computes, so a run scores 14 metrics - 11 free plus 3 judged (faithfulness, answer_correctness, context_recall_llm). It is dropped as the weakest and priciest precision signal for HERB: HERB ships gold citation ids, so retrieval precision is already measured exactly and judge-free by context_precision_id and softly by context_precision_nonllm, both kept and always run, while the LLM variant adds only a noisy judge-model-dependent third reading, is the ONLY per-context metric at roughly k judge calls per question so it drove the k-cost and was the slow NIM-throttled pass, and on the Qwen judge it hit a deterministic empty-completion failure. The retrieval-precision story therefore leads with the exact context_precision_id
